note: Closed variety of the run record, read ONLY through driver_journal.run_record / run_record_names. run_classes: the values STORY_RUN_CLASS may carry besides the default (a run that sets nothing is live; a value not listed here is unknown, never live). resume_kinds: the ROAD of a resumed role row (`resume_kind` of driver-runs.jsonl), one token per road, never a class of the refusal text; a caller that names none, or a token not listed here, is unclassified. rework_kinds: the roads on which a check, a critic or a refusal sent the role back to its own work; every name must be a name of resume_kinds. NOT rework: person_answer, stand_answers, service_cut; unclassified is neither and is counted on its own line.
